class.name: CrimsonMultiplayerRules
class.brief_description: Admission and transport settings for listen and dedicated co-op games.

members.member: Allow guests to join an active world. Keep this enabled for immediate listen and dedicated sessions. Use coordinated lobbies for games that close admission before play.
Total player capacity. Listen hosting uses one seat for the host and requires at least two seats. Dedicated hosting makes every seat available to guests. Spawn points supply placements separately.
UDP port used to listen for guests and connect to a host. Host and guest must use the same port, from 1 to 65535.
